body: Chief: please cross-review the W3 correction candidate a15396e (parent 9f6b0f8; embed-core author's eyes): the closed table detector must verify each mapped destination substring equals the configured pseudonym for its entry (typed error, no surface); re-run the impersonation probe (same id + config, foreign finder — must be inexpressible), the UNLISTED-SECRET probe (must be Left), and the four P0-1 laundering probes; check seams are out of main, SensitiveKeySnapshot.capture is used, and the ADR zero-hit rule.
